name: happyhorse-1.1-i2v
description: HappyHorse-1.1-I2V supports image-to-video generation, further enhancing visual quality, motion performance, and cross-clip consistency. The model can more accurately interpret input images and carry through creative intent, delivering significant improvements in skin texture rendering, ID preservation across clips, motion fluidity, text rendering stability, and audio-visual synchronization—producing higher-quality videos that are more realistic and natural, rich in detail, and more consistent.
zhDescription: HappyHorse-1.1-I2V支持图生视频，进一步提升画面质感、动态表现与跨片段一致性。模型能够更精准地理解输入图像并延续创作意图，在人物皮肤质感、ID跨片段保持、动作流畅度、文字渲染稳定性以及音画同步上带来显著改善，输出更真实自然、细节丰富且一致性更高的高质量视频。
